detail.title: WAKE Research Update: Reasoning Blind Spots and Protocol Refinement
detail.summary: This update focuses on addressing the invalid measurement results in the reasoning blind spot project (proj-reasoning-blind-spots). The research direction is set to collect necessary evidence for a revised notebook synthesis, as the current state lacks valid excerpt support for the mandated revisions.
